title: BigP3BCI Study K — 9x8 adaptive/checkerboard, 2 sessions (5 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset is Study K of the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface speller resource. It contains 16-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 5 healthy participants across two sessions, using a 9x8 character grid with adaptive and checkerboard stimulus paradigms. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags, and the data are reformatted in BIDS form for machine-learning benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) using 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz, with 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a P300 speller task with online feedback in a laboratory setting. Events were labeled as Target or NonTarget within 1 s epochs, and data were organized for calibration-then-test evaluation.
